Historical background and Chishui map assets

origin-yudu-ferry.webp
Photo by Zhangzhugang, 30 May 2014.
Central Red Army Long March starting-point ferry memorial, Yudu.
Source https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Yudu_Zhongyang_Hongjun_Changzheng_Diyi_Dukou_2014.05.30_11-12-33.jpg
License CC BY-SA 3.0 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/
Changes resized, encoded as WebP, cropped in the layout. The adapted image retains CC BY-SA 3.0.

conference.webp
Photo by Xiquinho Silva, 20 June 2024.
Photograph of a commemorative relief, not a wartime photograph.
Source https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Zunyi_Conference_Site.jpg
License CC BY 4.0 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Changes resized, encoded as WebP, cropped in the layout.

archive.webp
Unknown photographer, 1930s. A cadre addresses Red Army personnel.
The available metadata does not identify this as a photograph taken at Yudu in October 1934.
Source https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Long-march.jpg
Public domain as recorded on the source file page, PD-China / PD-1996.

chishui-relief.webp
Hillshade and hypsometric shading calculated from Mapzen Terrain Tiles aggregated elevation data.
Public AWS Terrarium data https://registry.opendata.aws/terrain-tiles/
Attribution https://www.mapzen.com/rights/
Source-provider attribution https://github.com/tilezen/joerd/blob/master/docs/attribution.md
USGS SRTM and other applicable aggregated source data. This is a present-day terrain rendering.
Bounds in WGS84 west 105.60, south 27.67, east 106.63, north 28.47. Projection Web Mercator.

chishui-map-data.json and the geographic data in src/chishui-map.json
River geometry and most place localities © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0.
https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/
Retrieved 7 November 2026 through the Overpass API.
The derived geographic data are made available in chishui-map-data.json under ODbL 1.0.
Jiuxikou locality coordinates use NGA-derived geographical-name data at
https://geographic.org/geographic_names/name.php?c=china&fid=1184&uni=10847436
The place markers represent approximate localities. They do not identify surveyed locations of 1935 pontoon bridges.
Short arrows indicate the historically documented crossing direction, not exact marching tracks.
Historical sequence https://www.cac.gov.cn/2016-08/22/c_1119430867.htm
Jiuxikou historical description https://www.sdcs1935.com/html/yanjiu/sdcsyz/202101/32fdc7ee66c9ef9c.shtml

Image replacements — 8 November 2026

Selection: contemporary records first (including eyewitness sketches), later artworks
second, documented present-day photographs third. No AI depiction remains in the
active exhibition. Maps are geographic data renderings, not generated landscapes.
New files below are resized/re-encoded as WebP without retouching or invented detail.
The gallery displays the complete images. The cover and chapter panels crop at display time.
Copyright in the new artworks and publication photographs remains with the respective
rights holders. No blanket open license is asserted; the source pages are provenance,
not licenses. Existing Commons assets above retain their original license conditions.

File: evidence-yudu.webp
Title: 星夜渡过雩都河
Artist: 黄镇 (Huang Zhen), eyewitness sketch from the Long March.
Source: 天津日报, 从亲历者黄镇速写看红军长征, 28 September 2026.
https://epaper.tianjinwe.com/tjrb/html/2026-09/28/content_143090_3879160.htm
Image: https://epaper.tianjinwe.com/tjrb/resfile/2026-09-28/07/p1_b.jpg
The source corrects an older misidentification as 过湘江; this depicts Yudu, not Xiang River.

File: evidence-luding.webp
Title: 泸定桥
Artist: 黄镇 (Huang Zhen), eyewitness sketch.
Same Tianjin Daily source; image:
https://epaper.tianjinwe.com/tjrb/resfile/2026-09-28/07/p2_b.jpg

File: art-xiang.webp
Title: 湘江·1934
Artist: 张庆涛 (Zhang Qingtao).
Source: 深圳大学传播学院, 红军故事｜湘江战役 英魂永存！
https://cmc.szu.edu.cn/info/1127/1762.htm
The original publication's image includes its watermark, retained unchanged.
The source says completed in 2010; no year is asserted in the image caption because
other publications use differing creation dates.

File: art-zunyi.webp
Title: 遵义会议; artist: 沈尧伊 (Shen Yaoyi).
File: art-jinsha.webp
Title: 巧渡金沙江 (1951); artist: 张漾兮 (Zhang Yangxi).
File: art-snow.webp
Title: 红军过雪山 (1957); artist: 艾中信 (Ai Zhongxin).
File: art-marsh.webp
Title: 革命理想高于天 (1975); artist: 沈尧伊 (Shen Yaoyi).
Source for these four digital reproductions: 共产党员网,
“图步”长征路，纪念长征胜利85周年, 21 October 2021.
https://www.12371.cn/2021/10/21/ARTI1634810104798403.shtml
Image URLs, in the order listed above:
https://p4.img.cctvpic.com/photoworkspace/contentimg/2021/10/21/2021102118562096188.jpg
https://p3.img.cctvpic.com/photoworkspace/contentimg/2021/10/21/2021102118565918629.jpg
https://p4.img.cctvpic.com/photoworkspace/contentimg/2021/10/21/2021102118580624918.jpg
https://p5.img.cctvpic.com/photoworkspace/contentimg/2021/10/21/2021102118585251329.jpg
These are later artistic interpretations, not photographs of 1934–1935 events.
The source publication's frames are retained in the gallery.

File: art-chishui.webp
Title: 四渡赤水 (1976).
Artists: 申根源、梅肖青、孙向阳、王天任.
Source: 北京组工, 庆祝中国共产党成立100周年.
https://zt.bjdj.gov.cn/rdztarticle/29714.html
Image: https://ks3-cn-beijing.ksyun.com/zgw/article/29714/content/20210519161525_171.jpg

File: memorial-wuqi.webp
Subject: victory-reunion memorial sculpture, Central Red Army Long March Victory
Memorial Museum, Shengli Mountain, Wuqi. This is a modern memorial photograph.
Source: 中国纪检监察报 / 延安纪检监察网, 胜利山上再出发.
https://yanan.qinfeng.gov.cn/info/1178/27011.htm
Image: https://yanan.qinfeng.gov.cn/__local/F/66/A8/7997F6A570DFA716350C464010D_219FABF1_397E0.png
The publication provides no named photographer or sculptor in its caption;
they are not invented here.

File: evidence-reunion.webp
Subject: cadres of the First, Second and Fourth Front Armies, 1936, Gonghe town,
Gansu (甘肃宫和镇, as specified by the source caption). Photographer unknown.
Source: 共产党员网, 百年瞬间丨红军三大主力胜利会师, 9 October 2021.
https://www.12371.cn/2021/10/09/VIDE1633740241787329.shtml
Image: https://p1.img.cctvpic.com/photoworkspace/contentimg/2021/10/09/2021100909234150671.jpg
This is a related group portrait, not a photograph claimed to show the Huining
or Jiangtaibao reunion ceremony itself.
